metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 higher over Wuhan, China in February 2020 than in February 2019?

- Bands: Try to auto-detect PM2.5 band from band names (pm2p5 variants).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes for both periods; attempt fallbacks. If none have data: C1.
- Compute mean over region; use pixel count to detect C2 (0 valid pixels).
- If mean is null/NaN: C3.
- Compare 2020 vs 2019 means to decide A or B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

// Helper to promisify getInfo calls
function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObject.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]).buffer(25000).bounds();
    const d19s = '2019-02-01';
    const d19e = '2019-03-01';
    const d20s = '2020-02-01';
    const d20e = '2020-03-01';
    const scale = 10000;

    // Candidate datasets and band detection
    const datasetIds = [
      'ECMWF/CAMS/NRT',
      'ECMWF/CAMS/REANALYSIS',
      'ECMWF/CAMS/Global_atmospheric_composition_forecasts',
      'ECMWF/CAMS/Global_reanalysis_eac4'
    ];
    const preferredBands = [
      'pm2p5',
      'particulate_matter_d_less_than_2p5_um_surface',
      'pm2_5',
      'particulate_matter_2p5um',
      'mass_concentration_of_pm2p5_in_air',
      'pm2p5_surface',
      'pm25',
      'pm2p5_conc'
    ];

    async function tryDataset(id) {
      try {
        const colAll = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterBounds(wuhan).filterDate(d19s, d20e);
        const sizeAll = await getInfoAsync(colAll.size());
        if (!sizeAll || sizeAll === 0) return null;

        // Band detection
        const firstImg = ee.Image(colAll.first());
        const bandNames = await getInfoAsync(firstImg.bandNames());
        if (!bandNames || bandNames.length === 0) return null;

        // Find PM2.5 band
        let band = null;
        const lowerBands = bandNames.map(b => String(b).toLowerCase());
        for (const cand of preferredBands) {
          const idx = lowerBands.indexOf(cand.toLowerCase());
          if (idx !== -1) {
            band = bandNames[idx];
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!band) {
          // Try heuristic search
          const idx = lowerBands.findIndex(b => (b.includes('pm2') || b.includes('2p5')) && (b.includes('pm') || b.includes('particul')));
          if (idx !== -1) band = bandNames[idx];
        }
        if (!band) return null;

        // Check both periods have images
        const col19 = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterBounds(wuhan).filterDate(d19s, d19e).select([band], ['pm']);
        const col20 = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterBounds(wuhan).filterDate(d20s, d20e).select([band], ['pm']);
        const n19 = await getInfoAsync(col19.size());
        const n20 = await getInfoAsync(col20.size());
        if ((n19 || 0) === 0 || (n20 || 0) === 0) return null;

        return { id, bandOriginal: band, col19, col20, n19, n20 };
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    let selection = null;
    for (const id of datasetIds) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
      const res = await tryDataset(id);
      if (res) { selection = res; break; }
    }

    if (!selection) {
      console.log('No images found for one or both periods after trying datasets.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const { id: usedId, bandOriginal, col19, col20, n19, n20 } = selection;

    // Mean composites
    const img19 = col19.mean(); // band name 'pm'
    const img20 = col20.mean();

    // Pixel counts
    const countDict19 = await getInfoAsync(img19.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const countDict20 = await getInfoAsync(img20.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const px19 = countDict19 ? (countDict19.pm || 0) : 0;
    const px20 = countDict20 ? (countDict20.pm || 0) : 0;

    if (px19 === 0 || px20 === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, Band: ${bandOriginal}`);
      console.log(`2019 Images: ${n19}, Pixels: ${px19}`);
      console.log(`2020 Images: ${n20}, Pixels: ${px20}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Mean values
    const meanDict19 = await getInfoAsync(img19.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const meanDict20 = await getInfoAsync(img20.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const m19 = meanDict19 ? meanDict19.pm : null;
    const m20 = meanDict20 ? meanDict20.pm : null;

    const bad19 = (m19 === null || m19 === undefined || Number.isNaN(m19));
    const bad20 = (m20 === null || m20 === undefined || Number.isNaN(m20));
    if (bad19 || bad20) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, Band: ${bandOriginal}`);
      console.log(`2019 Images: ${n19}, Pixels: ${px19}, Mean: ${m19}`);
      console.log(`2020 Images: ${n20}, Pixels: ${px20}, Mean: ${m20}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = m20 - m19;

    // Print concise evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, Band: ${bandOriginal}`);
    console.log(`2019 Images: ${n19}`);
    console.log(`2019 Mean: ${Number(m19).toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${px19}`);
    console.log(`2020 Images: ${n20}`);
    console.log(`2020 Mean: ${Number(m20).toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${px20}`);
    console.log(`Diff (2020-2019): ${Number(diff).toFixed(6)}`);

    // Final Answer: A if higher in 2020, else B
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected errors -> D
    try {
      console.log('D');
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.log('D');
    }
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
